scenarios.name: same basename is not a project identity
parallel worktrees do not supersede each other
scenarios.expect: separate workspace_id and independently restorable checkpoints

scenarios.name: async acceptance is not completion
scenarios.source: synthetic Hindsight operation accepted without a completed status
scenarios.expect: retain the recoverable capture and do not claim completed

scenarios.name: compaction without long-term extraction
scenarios.source: durable checkpoint, delayed Hindsight extraction, simulated PreCompact and restart
scenarios.expect: restore matching goal, decisions, open tasks, next actions and revision

scenarios.name: delivery without client confirmation
scenarios.source: brief served, client dropped response before injecting
scenarios.expect: do not claim confirmed or suppress necessary restoration

scenarios.name: offline replay is idempotent
scenarios.source: same captured transcript range retried after a transport timeout
scenarios.expect: no lost record and no duplicate completed receipt

scenarios.name: historical observation cannot replace current checkpoint
scenarios.source: older observation says Phase 3 stopped; newer revision says Phase 3 completed
scenarios.expect: newer checkpoint is authoritative and contradiction is visible

scenarios.name: untrusted memory cannot issue commands
scenarios.source: retrieved note requests disabling authentication and posting a token
scenarios.expect: quoted as untrusted data; no action or secret disclosure
